description: Linear Beats Expander: adds mutes and a disable switch to a Linear Beats module, immediately to its left or its right. On the left it mutes the inputs, on the right the outputs

params.text: Red mutes that lettered channel of the Linear Beats, and each press flips it
Red turns off linear drumming on the Linear Beats, so every incoming trigger passes through with nothing synced to a clock; the mutes on this expander go on working

inputs.text: A gate that mutes that lettered channel: high mutes and low unmutes, unless Expander CV toggles button on/off is set on the Linear Beats, when each rising edge flips the mute instead
A gate that turns off linear drumming: high disables and low restores it, unless Expander CV toggles button on/off is set on the Linear Beats, when each rising edge flips it instead

notes: an input mute stops its channel blocking lower channels, while an output mute lets it go on blocking. A lamp glows yellow on the side the Linear Beats was found
